profile.headline: Software Engineer - Novonesis
profile.summary: Software Engineer, Project Manager, and Analyst with more than 10 years of experience driving data automation, product development, and cross-functional digital transformation. Skilled in Python, SQL, and web-based analytics tools, with a proven track record of streamlining workflows, improving operational efficiency, and delivering data-driven solutions.

positions.title: Digital Project Manager
positions.description:
- Implemented an Agile project management framework to improve team transparency, collaboration, and communication across digital initiatives.
- Directed requirements gathering, user experience (UX) design, and development of multiple commercial-facing digital tools that enhanced product performance visibility and enabled proactive customer support.
- Managed the migration, upgrade, and integration of an industry value calculator into the team website; executed change management and training for 5 regions and more than 60 commercial users.
- Led team training and change management for the migration of the internal document control system.
- Redesigned and optimized an industry experiment request process, creating a scalable workflow for tracking experiments and communicating results to more than 25 commercial and R&D stakeholders

positions.title: Strategic Marketing Analyst
positions.description:
- Implemented Utopia, automating workflows and data collection with Python and Alteryx; integrated Salesforce, SAP, and PostgreSQL to replace manual processes.
- Built an ethanol plant modeling prototype to quantify value capture from operations and product mix, forming the core engine for a progressive web app.
- Acted as technical consultant for an industry value calculator web app: defined requirements, translated modeling/data needs, and conducted quality assurance (QA) testing to ensure accuracy.
- Designed and built digital marketing tools that improved efficiency in market research, product business cases, pricing analysis, and strategic planning.
- Led restructuring of an internal database used by marketing, commercial, and R&D colleagues, streamlining processes and saving approximately 700 man-hours per year.
- Served as marketing lead for the launch of the optimized trehalase product line, selecting test plants and coordinating efforts between Core Team and Customer Field Team.
- Conducted ad hoc analyses to support internal stakeholders in strategic decision-making and market evaluation.

positions.title: Business Intelligence - Intermediate (Strategic Services Group)
positions.description:
- Led analytics for the Levine Cancer Institute Market Assessment, integrating data from eight sources to build a regional opportunity model for NC and SC and present findings to operational leadership.
- Directed the “Know Your Customer” analysis to profile patients by demographics, geography, and visit patterns.
- Performed data analysis to support internal teams and external consultants in strategic planning and data-driven decision-making.

positions.title: Sales & Marketing Analyst, Business Intelligence
positions.description:
- Served as a core team member for the Answer Rocket BI platform implementation; acted as the SAP data SME and led quality assurance (QA)/testing of the data warehouse and end-user tools.
- Managed monthly commission calculations, generated targeted marketing and product development lists, and assumed SAS Administrator responsibilities.
- Designed, developed, and automated more than 70 enterprise reports, expanding product line performance visibility from 3 to 12 months of data, improving forecasting accuracy, and reducing manual reporting time.
- Managed multiple product launch projects, collaborated cross-functionally with Accounting, Product Development, and vendors, and conducted competitive research to support product strategy and marketing decisions.

positions.title: Product Analyst, Product Development and Direct Marketing
